scope: Committed narrow healthcheck fix and regression plus operational evidence

minor.impact: Portable host-only execution is weaker evidence than the recorded image execution.
minor.disposition: deferred; recorded RED/GREEN inside the real image and real Compose healthy status are authoritative
minor.finding: Regression resolves the configured executable from the executor PATH; a host containing curl cannot reproduce the original missing-image-executable failure.

outside_exercised_scope: Universal absence of network traffic or secrets beyond instrumented APIs/application tree
